The '''Shadow Hand Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] loyal to the [[Dark Empire]] and was in charge of carrying out [[Operation Shadow Hand]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
First thought of by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] as he awaited the arrival of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the "Shadow Hand Strategy" would involve major military assets of the former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], including an enormous naval task force to enforce it.<ref name="DESB" /> In accordance with the strategy, fleets of warships participating in the campaign fanned out in waves from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], conquering nearby worlds.<ref name="DE" /> Although they gained footholds in [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] territory, following the final death of the reborn [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the campaign faltered and the remaining ships were absorbed by various Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]].<ref name="TEC" />
